# Project documents (generated by the GX kit; keep this index current)

| File | Job | Written by | Changes when |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00-project-card.md | Client, industry, country, stack, scale, compliance, deadline | You | Rarely |
| 01-prd.md | Objective, users, needs, features, constraints, out of scope | You | After sign-off, only via a change request |
| brand/ | Brand guide, tokens.json, contrast report | You supply, `brandtokens.py` converts | Brand changes |
| features/_industry-brief.md | How this industry works, competitors, rules | Claude (gx-analyst) | Once, then when facts change |
| features/F-xx-*.md | Per-feature analysis | Claude (gx-analyst), you review | When the feature changes |
| 02-roadmap.md | Phases, milestones, gates, dates | Claude proposes, you approve | Only via change request |
| 03-traceability.md | Goal to feature to milestone to task | Generated (`prdtool.py trace`) | Every task |
| STATUS.md | Live status of milestones, features, tasks | Claude, end of every session | Every session |
| reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md | Weekly client report | Generated (`prdtool.py report`) | Weekly |
| changes/CR-xxx.md | One change request per file | Claude drafts, you decide | When scope moves |

Rules: permanent IDs, one source of truth per fact (scope in the PRD, dates in the roadmap, status in STATUS.md), testable words only,
baseline at `prd-v1.0`, client view generated from these files. Commands: `python3 .claude/gx/bin/prdtool.py lint | check | trace | report | status`.
